measures.name: 連續3次銷量下降 GroupByAssay
measures.expression:
VAR vCutOffDate =
			    EDATE ( [Max_SalesDate_絕對], -6 )
			VAR vTable =
			    CALCULATETABLE (
			        ADDCOLUMNS (
			            SUMMARIZE (
			                F_Sales_Order,
			                D_Customer[Customer_Name],
			                D_Product[Assay],
			                F_Sales_Order[Order_Month]
			            ),
			            "Sales", [銷售額 MTD]
			        ),
			        ALL ( D_DateTable )
			    )
			VAR Top1_Table =
			    TOPN ( 1, vTable, [Order_Month], DESC )
			VAR Top1_Date =
			    MINX ( Top1_Table, [Order_Month] )
			VAR Top1_Sales =
			    MAXX ( FILTER ( Top1_Table, [Order_Month] = Top1_Date ), [Sales] )
			VAR Top2_Table =
			    TOPN ( 2, vTable, [Order_Month], DESC )
			VAR Top2_Date =
			    MINX ( Top2_Table, [Order_Month] )
			VAR Top2_Sales =
			    MAXX ( FILTER ( Top2_Table, [Order_Month] = Top2_Date ), [Sales] )
			VAR Top3_Table =
			    TOPN ( 3, vTable, [Order_Month], DESC )
			VAR Top3_Date =
			    MINX ( Top3_Table, [Order_Month] )
			VAR Top3_Sales =
			    MAXX ( FILTER ( Top3_Table, [Order_Month] = Top3_Date ), [Sales] )
			RETURN
			    SWITCH (
			        TRUE (),
			        Top1_Sales < Top2_Sales
			            && Top2_Sales < Top3_Sales
			            && Top1_Date >= vCutOffDate, 1,
			        //最後一次銷量在近6個月內
			        0
			    )
